standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's lemmas at source lines 703-705 and 714-716, whose proofs are delivered by this lane's cards for those statements

core_obligations: Fix a set U of size between 1 and u_0 satisfying the Tutte-violation relation and take it minimal; by the author's minimality lemma every vertex of U has neighbours in at least three components of the graph minus U (proof lines 1039-1053).

Split according to the size of the edge boundary of U: if the boundary is large, the probability that the required edges are absent is small by a first-moment count; if the boundary is small, the author's counting lemma for sets with a small boundary bounds the number of candidate sets (proof lines 1039-1053).
Union bound over the sizes of U and over the set U itself concludes that with high probability no such set exists, simultaneously in the whole window of p (proof lines 1039-1053).
proof_roadmap: 先取最小的违反集 U：由最小性引理，U 的每个顶点至少与 G_p - U 的三个分量相邻。
再按 U 的边边界大小分情形：边界大则首次矩估计给出概率上界，边界小则用集合计数引理控制候选集个数，最后对所有 |U| <= u_0 取并集界。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the size bound for small Tutte obstructions in the whole window of edge probabilities (author lemma at source lines 671-673, label lem:no-small-tutte). The proof (source lines 1039-1053) is the author's own explicit Proof of lem:no-small-tutte, and it consumes the two structural lemmas of the surrounding subsection: the minimality lemma on the components met by every vertex of an obstruction and the two counting lemmas on sets with a small boundary. The argument is what makes the random part of the paper's main theorem uniform in p over the window, which the author stresses in the statement. H2.
